name: appium
description: Prerequisites: Install Node.js (v14.x or later): Download Node.js Install Appium: Run npm install -g appium in the terminal to install Appium globally. Install Appium Desktop: Download Appium Desktop (optional for GUI-based debugging). Install Android Studio: Download and set up Android Studio to use Android emulators. Install Appium Drivers: For mobile automation, install Appium drivers (e.g., appium@next for the latest version).
